label: Patient Id
definition: Patient ID in the center providing the information

label: Gender
definition: Gender of the patient

label: Ethnicity
definition: Ethnicity of the patient

label: Birth Date
definition: Date of birth of the patient

label: Death Date
definition: Date of death of the patient

label: Provider  Center  Id
definition: Center ID of the center providing the information

label: Origin  Center  Id
definition: Center ID of the center of origin of the patient

label: Cause of death
definition: Description of the cause of death of the patient

label: Last News Date
definition: Date of last news (= date of last patient visit if there is no other information available) (day is set to the 15th)

label: Last News Status
definition: Indicator of the patient's last known vital status (alive or deceased)

label: Date
definition: Date of consent signature

label: Genetic Analysis Authorization
definition: Consent for genetic analysis

label: Pathology Code
definition: International code for the related disease (other than cancer). 3 characters.

label: Diagnosis Date
definition: Date of diagnosis for the related disease.

label: Pathology End Date
definition: Date of the end of the related disease (if occuring and known)

label: Topography Code
definition: International code for the localization of the oncologic primary site

label: Parentage
definition: Family relationship

label: Type
definition: The field 'Type' allows to describe the 'Cancer' event as a global disease, as well as the various events constituting this disease (primary tumor, local relapse, metastatic relapse...)

label: Start Date
definition: Date of start of cancer event or disease

label: End Date
definition: Date of end of cancer event or disease

label: Performance Status
definition: Definition of the autonomy scale (Karnofsky scale or OMS)

label: G8 score
definition: Tool for the evaluation of the general condition of the patient

label: Histological Grade Type
required: optional, mandatory if HistologicalGradeValue is set
definition: List of histological grading scales

label: Histological Grade Value
required: optional, mandatory if HistologicalGradeType is set
definition: Value of histological grade

label: Stade Type
required: optional, mandatory if StadeValue is set
definition: List of stage scales

label: Stade Value
required: optional, mandatory if StadeType is set
definition: Stage value

label: Diagnosis Date
definition: Date of diagnosis of the tumor event

label: Topography Code
definition: Localisation of the primary tumor

label: Morphology Code
definition: International code of lesion / histological type / tumor morphology of the tumoral event

label: Laterality
definition: Laterality of location (if it exists)

label: T
required: optional, mandatory if either N, M or TNMType is set
definition: Size of the tumor, propagation the site of the primary tumor

label: N
required: optional, mandatory if either T, M or TNMType is set
definition: Propagation at the ganglion level

label: M
required: optional, mandatory if either T, N or TNMType is set
definition: Remote propagation, presence of metastases

label: TNM Version
definition: TNM classification version

label: TNM Type
required: optional, mandatory if either T, N or M is set

label: Code
definition: Code of analysis

label: Type
definition: Type of analysis

label: Date
definition: Date of analysis

label: Date
definition: Date of assessment of treatment response

label: Status
definition: Assessment of treatment response

label: Code
definition: Biomarker name

label: Value
definition: Biomarker value

label: Unit
definition: Biomarker unit

label: Type
definition: Type of treatment

label: Line Number
definition: Line of treatment

label: Activity Code
definition: CCAM code of the medical act

label: Start Date
definition: Date of treatment start

label: End Date
definition: Date of treatment end

label: Clinical Trial Context
definition: Treatment performed in a clinical study setting

label: Clinical Trial Name
definition: Name of the clinical study

label: Clinical Trial Id
definition: NCT identifier of the clinical study

label: Surgery Resection Quality
definition: Quality of resection (anapath)

label: Surgery Nature
definition: Nature of the surgery

label: Code
definition: International code of the adverse event occurring during treatment (excluding other cancer), only the first 4 letters.

label: Date
definition: Date of the diagnosis of the adverse event

label: End Date
definition: End date of the adverse event (if known)

label: Grade
definition: Grade of the adverse event

label: Code
definition: Therapeutic classification code (5th level if possible)

label: Name
definition: Name of the molecule

label: Sample External Accession
definition: Unique identifier of the sample

label: Parent sample External Accession
definition: Unique identifier of the parent sample (if there is one, example histo#)

label: Collect Date
definition: Date of sampling

label: Topography Code
definition: Code of tumor localization

label: Nature
definition: Nature of the sample

label: Origin
definition: Nature of the original sample (Healthy or Tumoral)

label: Storage Temperature
definition: Mode of preservation

label: Tumor Cellularity
definition: Percentage of tumor cells quantified in the sample

label: Technical Protocol
definition: Protocol used for the experiment

label: Platform Name
definition: Technological platform name (provider followed by the platform name)

label: Platform Accession
definition: GEO Identifier of the platform

label: Date Of Experiment
definition: Date when the experiment was performed

label: Name
definition: Name of the panel targeted by the experimental analysis (provider followed by the panel name)

label: Analytic Pipeline Code
definition: Identifier of the pipeline used into the analysis (unique in the center)

label: Algorithmic Cellularity
definition: Calculated percentage of tumor cells in sample

label: Algorithmic Ploidy
definition: Calculated number of sets of chromosomes in a cell of the sample

label: Number Of Break Points
definition: Calculated number of break points in genomic profile

label: Alteration Type
definition: General type of the detected genetic alteration (high level type)

label: Pathogenicity
definition: Conclusion of the biologist on the pathogenicity of the variant before the Molecular Tumor Board

label: Actionability
definition: Conclusion of the clinicians wether the variant is actionable or not during the Molecular Tumor Board

label: Proposed For Orientation
definition: Is the ClinicalTumorBoardConclusion used to orient the treatment decision ?

label: Type
definition: Type of validation of the detected alteration

label: Method
definition: Validation method depending on the type of validation

label: Status
definition: Validation status of the detected alteration

label: Chromosome
definition: Chromosome containing the genetic finding

label: Genomic Start
definition: Nucleotide location for start of genomic finding on the positive (+) genomics strand, 1-based

label: Genomic Stop
definition: Nucleotide location for end of genomic finding on the positive (+) genomic strand, 1-based

label: Genome Build
definition: Genome Build used for reference

label: Cytoband
definition: Cytogenetic location

label: Type
definition: Type of the genome entity. For eg: gene, mRNA, ncRNA...

label: Database
definition: Database of the genome entity

label: Id
definition: Identifier of the genome entity in the genome entity database

label: Symbol
definition: Hugo gene symbol

label: Type
definition: Type of the fusion event. For eg: translocation, readthrough

label: Point 5 prime
definition: Position of the fusion point on the 5 prime partner

label: Point 3 prime
definition: Position of the fusion point on the 3 prime partner

label: In Frame
definition: Specify whether the fusion is in frame

label: Nb Spanning Pair
definition: Number of reads pairs spanning the fusion

label: Nb Split Reads
definition: Number of reads containing the fusion point

label: Segment Intensity
definition: Intensity of the measured signal

label: Segment Genomic Status
definition: Copy number status

label: Copy Number
definition: Estimated DNA copy number

label: LOH
definition: Is the segment located in a region of loss of heterozygosity ? (can be independant from copy number information

label: Reference Allele
definition: Plus strand reference allele at this position. Include the sequence deleted for a deletion, or '-' for an insertion.

label: Alternative Allele
definition: Plus strand observed alternative allele at this position. Include the sequence inserted for a insertion, or '-' for a deletion.

label: DNA Sequence Variation Type
definition: Codified type of the DNA sequence variation

label: Mutation Prediction Algorithm
definition: Algorithm to predict the variation effect over the protein

label: Mutation Prediction Value
definition: Prediction of the variation effect over the protein

label: Mutation Prediction Score
definition: Level of confidence of the prediction of the variation effect over the protein

label: Pfam Domain
definition: Pfams domains related to alteration position

label: Pfam Id
definition: Identifier of Pfams domains related to alteration position

label: DNA Region Name
definition: Human readable name for the region of interest related to the transcript (eg: exon1, intron1, UTR3')

label: DNA Sequence Variation
definition: HGVS nomenclature on the chosen transcript

label: Amino Acid Change
definition: HGVS nomenclature on the chosen protein transcript

label: Genomic Sequence Variation
definition: HGVS nomenclature on the given GenomeReferenceSequenceId.

label: RNA Sequence Variation
definition: HGVS nomenclature on the given TranscriptReferenceSequenceId and experimentely observed on RNA.

label: Amino Acid Change Type
definition: nomenclature of changes at protein-level

label: Fusion Prime End
definition: Prime end of the fusion partner

label: Strand
definition: Strand

label: OnSplicingSite
definition: Indicate wether the variant is on a splicing site

label: Position Read Depth
definition: Total sequencing depth at the variant position observed in the specimen

label: Variant Read Depth
definition: Sequencing depth of the alternative allele at the variant position observed in the specimen

label: Strand Bias
definition: Indication of the existence of strand bias at the variant position

label: Genomic Source Class
definition: Genomic class of the variant (eg: germline, somatic, and prenatal)

label: Allelic State
definition: Level of allelic occurrence of a DNA Sequence Variation

label: Data Type
definition: Type of the expression value corresponding to the level of data processing

label: Value
definition: Numerical value for expression
